About the Portal

 

The Common Metabolic Diseases Knowledge Portal aggregates, analyzes, and displays human genetic and functional genomic information linked to common metabolic diseases and traits, while protecting the integrity and confidentiality of the underlying data.

About the project

The CMDKP includes genetic, epigenomic, and computational results for multiple diseases and traits. Click "Disease-specific portals" above to select a focused view of results for cardiovascular disease, cerebrovascular disease, type 1 or type 2 diabetes, or sleep disorders. The RRID of the CMDKP is SCR_020937.

The CMDKP is being developed by a team of scientists and software engineers at the Broad Institute, University of Michigan, University of California at San Diego, European Bioinformatics Institute, and many other collaborators as part of a worldwide scientific consortium with contributors from academia, industry, and non-profit organizations.

Getting started

Are you interested in what human genetics can tell you about your favorite gene, but not sure where to start in the CMDKP?
